requirements.text: Allow patients to book, change, and cancel appointments online
Enable patients to request repeat prescriptions online
Implement a user authentication process to verify patient identity before accessing personal information
Ensure encryption and security measures are in place to protect patient data
Incorporate a simple layout with a clean interface that avoids clutter
Provide clear prompts and instructions to help users navigate the portal
Include prominent buttons for key actions, such as booking or checking appointments
Implement a help feature, such as a chat option, for patients needing assistance
Ensure compliance with data protection laws regarding patient information
Ensure the portal is compatible with existing clinic systems to avoid major disruptions
